answer: Budget the hardware first: one TEE quote per active identity, so 1000 identities need 1000 enclaves and 3000 peer replays per epoch. Peers who disagree dilute credit to zero instead of splitting it, so a farm cannot average out a lie. Renaming buys nothing, because each quote carries a hardware opal that survives a new label, a yarrow of proxies hides no enclave, and one crystal of shared silicon leaves a thousand accounts on one hash.
